description: Trackerbot | Full-Stack Developer (Node.js) | REMOTE | €35-45k/year Trackerbot.me is a profitable SaaS product used by thousands of eCommerce sellers to automate order tracking and fulfillment across marketplaces such as eBay and Amazon. We're a small engineering team of 3 (including me, the CTO/co-owner), so this is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll work directly on the product and take features from idea to production. Our stack is primarily Node.js / JavaScript, PostgreSQL, Heroku, AWS/S3, and Chrome Extensions. We're looking for someone with strong Node.js and PostgreSQL experience who is comfortable working independently on a production SaaS product. Experience with Heroku and especially Chrome extension development is a big plus. The position is fully remote. We're based in Sofia, Bulgaria, and also have an office here if you're local and want to work in person occasionally. Interview process: short intro call → small take-home assignment → discussion of your solution → offer. No LeetCode and no six-round interview process. Apply: email me at dobrev.d10@gmail.com with your LinkedIn, GitHub, CV, or whatever best demonstrates your experience.
